endorsements.name: Kim Jeong-Hoon
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37279
endorsements.description: easy-pdf-merge 0.1.0 through 0.2.6 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute commands by injecting shell metacharacters into source paths, destination path, or maxHeap option. Attackers can supply file names or options containing double quotes, semicolons, $() or backticks, which child_process.exec() runs through a shell with the Node.js process privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.2)

endorsements.name: Kim Jeong-Hoon
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-48011
endorsements.description: Servor 1.0.0 through 4.0.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to escape the served root by sending URL-encoded dot segments. Attackers can send %2e%2e/ sequences, which decodeURI() decodes before path.join() in serveStaticFile and serveDirectoryListing, to read arbitrary files and list directories outside the root.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)
